summary: SoundHound AI, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Merger Agreement to acquire LivePerson, Inc. via a merger of its wholly owned subsidiary Merger Sub into LivePerson, with LivePerson surviving as an indirect subsidiary. Consideration is stock: a fixed number of SoundHound Class A common shares (Aggregate Consideration Amount divided by a 30-day VWAP) exchanged for all LivePerson shares. No dollar price, premium, or advisor named. The merger is not expected to be tax-free. Watch for stock consideration valuation, regulatory clearance, and SoundHound's share price volatility as the deal currency.
